trace_identity.family_convention: explicit symmetric exact-affine infinite R33; synchronous target g0(delta)
trace_identity.integration_strategy: all initial nodes share one DOP853 grid, restarted at numerical radial knot representatives

knot_alignment.semantics: integration mesh only; the exact input function is not altered and omitted close knots may still be crossed

trace_identity.parameter_coordinate: exact R57 affine delta, not the legacy p label

limitations: Floating diagnostics at selected times and rays only.
No continuous parameter, time, or complex-angle bound is proved.
Finite primitive, root-centre, FFT/trig and quotient quadrature errors remain unpaid.
The exact identity does not make q a true Jacobian or Z a true variation.
